integrity_statement: All deductions and computational tests are stated with their limits. No independent audit or independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Counts only ordered pairwise-commuting idempotents of finite poset incidence algebras, their fixes under poset automorphisms, and their poset-automorphism orbits. The reduced commuting-idempotent variety has one component per diagonal coloring, with dimension equal to the bichromatic strict-pair-orbit number. The crown corollary uses simultaneous rotations, not full automorphism or unit conjugation. General ring-theoretic idempotent lifting is classical, and complete priority has not been independently established.
title: Equivariant commuting-idempotent spectra of finite incidence algebras and crown rotations
